content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've just started programming a [product_name] ([article_no], version without display). I'm trying to connect it to my laptop with an ethernet cable. When I go to the tool menu and try to add the device, it asks for the IP address – I entered the default 198.168.0.1 and some other random addresses, but it can't detect my [product_name]. Can someone please advise how to find the IP address for a [product_name] without display? Thanks, [user_name]

Which [product_name] model do you have exactly? Which [product_name] software version are you using? If you attempt to connect, press the blue double arrow in the transfer window. The software will search for all compatible devices and show any that it finds.

I can confirm it's [article_no] without display, and the only connection is via standard ethernet cable. Could someone explain how to find and change the address in the menu? I'm unsure which version it is, as it was manufactured in 2019.
Could you please provide answers to my previous questions?
Hello, try the buttons in the interface. The default IP address for a [product_name] is 192.168.0.3.

Adding some advice: If you don't know your device's IP, you can switch the software to network project view and choose to work online. It will search for all connected devices on your local network and display them. Once your device appears, you can right-click to access its properties and view or modify network settings.

Note that it might not be an IP address issue. Another possibility is using an incompatible software version. For instance, you might have [product_name] software version 8.0, but your device supports only version_no like 8.2 or 8.3.

analysis.insight_summary: Users working with [product_name] modules without displays experience difficulty identifying and configuring IP addresses for network-based programming, particularly when default or random IPs do not work. The main usability gap is unclear guidance for IP discovery in devices without displays. Built-in network search features in the programming software are mentioned as helpful but not immediately obvious for new users. Additionally, confusion regarding compatible software versions contributes to the challenge.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy and straightforward method, preferably integrated within the programming software, to discover the IP address of [product_name] modules without displays. They also hope for seamless connectivity across device models and software versions.
